omtp_about_tagline: Model hub and OpenAI-compatible gateway for SillyTavern — providers, models, reasoning effort and token accounting in one place.
omtp_about_feature_hub: One hub for every provider: search, favorites, recents, profiles and per-model details.
omtp_about_feature_gateway: Runs an OpenAI-compatible gateway that SillyTavern talks to, with streaming, tools and reasoning verbatim.
omtp_about_feature_providers: Sign-in for OAuth plans and API keys, with per-provider live model probing.
omtp_about_feature_usage: Quota pages for subscription providers, refreshed from each provider's own usage endpoint.
omtp_about_feature_stats: Token and cost accounting per chat, per model and per day, plus the local dashboard (`/omtp stats`).
omtp_about_data_body: Model metadata, pricing and capability flags come from OMP's models.json catalog; personality scores come from AA-PersonalityBench. Prices are estimates for orientation and are not a billing statement. Your credentials never leave the machine: they are encrypted under data/omtp and only used for requests you trigger.

omtp_about_slogan: We shall meet again at the far shore of the stars
omtp_about_omp_body: The gateway, the sign-in flow, the usage pages and the stats dashboard follow OMP's design and commands (`/login`, `/usage`, `stats`); the bundled catalog is derived from OMP's models.json.
omtp_login_needs_client_id: Set the OAuth client id in data/omtp/oauth-clients.json or the OMTP_*_CLIENT_ID environment variable.
